pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical and related health care products company' (FY2007 10-K, Item 7); 'In the pharmaceutical industry, the majority of an innovative product’s commercial value is usually realized during the period in which the product has market exclusivity.' (Item 1); 'The Company faces competition from other pharmaceutical manufacturers, including from lower-priced generic products, and it is possible that the Company may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'The patent infringement lawsuit with Apotex Inc. and Apotex Corp. (Apotex) involving PLAVIX* is ongoing, and there is a risk of generic competition from Apotex and from other generic pharmaceutical companies.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -49.3%/yr (worst year FY02-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (FY02-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +47.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2009-02-06) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.46x (74.0% downside to Bear $6 / +160.1% upside to Bull $60) | Adj composite 3.32 vs market 1.63: gap +1.69 [UNDERVALUED] | -18% above the EPP floor $28 (17x FY09E $1.66) | Conservative 2-yr case: +78.8% total (+39.4%/yr) | At 13.9x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $31 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +11.0% in Q4 2008, forward revenues +8% (no FY09 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2008 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
